dct_description_sm: This dataset contains temporal measurements of surface water nitrous oxide (N2O) and methane (CH4) concentrations on the west coast of Vancouver Island, BC during summer 2024. This data was collected using an automated, high-frequency measurement system. The system consisted of a gas extraction module connected to an off-axis integrated cavity output spectrometer (OA-ICOS) gas analyzer.
dct_subject_sm: Off-axis integrated cavity output spectroscopy (OA-ICOS) gas analyzer
dct_title_s: Temporal continuous measurements of surface water N2O and CH4 around Vancouver Island, British Columbia
